# JavaScript Jobs Hub

> > JavaScript Jobs Hub is a specialized job board and career resource platform connecting JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Node.js developers with opportunities worldwide.

The platform serves JavaScript developers across all experience levels, from junior to engineering management, with job listings in major tech markets (USA, Germany, Canada, Poland, Portugal) and comprehensive career guidance covering technical skills, job search strategies, resume optimization, freelancing, remote work, and the impact of AI on development careers.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript jobs
- TypeScript adoption
- React development
- Remote work opportunities
- Career advancement strategies
- Frontend development
- Full-stack development
- Node.js positions
- Job search optimization
- ATS resume strategies
- Freelance rate scaling
- Geographic arbitrage
- AI impact on developers
- Technical interview preparation
- Engineering management transition
